name: trellis
description: Trellis: QA workspace that reconciles documentation and test cases with an AI agent and Arbor memory

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @trellis/server" "npm run dev -w @trellis/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/changes && tsc -p packages/arbor-bridge && tsc -p packages/llm && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
